name: Istio Authorization Policy Review
summary: Review Istio AuthorizationPolicy, PeerAuthentication and RequestAuthentication together against intended access. Use for default-deny design, overlapping CUSTOM/DENY/ALLOW policies, empty rules, JWT requirements, wildcard principals, L7-on-TCP risks, policy targetRefs, trust identity or authorization regressions. Review supplied evidence only; separate policy semantics from observed enforcement and do not apply changes.
security_notes: Static review only. Evaluate the complete applicable policy set and keep missing rules, an empty rules list, and an empty matching rule distinct.
